I replied in a thread on Marcus's message in #north-random. I told them I've noted that the deadline for the signed order form at Thornbury Cloth Co. is 19 November.

They said no action was needed, so I didn't post anything in #north-team and didn't open their earlier message there. I offered to post a correction in #north-team if they want one. The brain saves channel messages automatically, so their correction is already recorded there.
